messages:
hana (design): quick roundup from the design review re: the routing policies editor simulation. two urgent accessibility + UX items: 1) SR announcements for reorder + sim summary need to be more human-friendly, 2) keyboard focus moves weirdly when the preview updates on narrow viewports. can we sync? @jules @tom
kevin (pm): noted. what's the exact behavior you're seeing for announcements?
hana (design): when I drag a rule the screen reader just says 'list updated' or '4 items' depending on OS. expected: something like 'Moved rule "Route to low-cost" to position 2' or 'Rule "Block external" disabled due to conflict'. also when the sim finishes the little summary toast isn't reachable by keyboard and isn't announced.
phil (research): lab notes: NVDA on Windows reads container changes as generic. VoiceOver similar. Users prefer explicit statements; generic counts cause confusion. participants asked for both: per-action concise announcements + a final summary announcement.
jules (frontend): implementation thought: two layers — lightweight assertive aria-live for per-action strings, and a polite aria-live for final summaries. downside: assertive can interrupt speech during heavy runs. can throttle or dedupe announcements.
tom (engineer): agree. i can add an srAnnouncer util component that accepts {type: 'move'|'state'|'summary', text}. debounce moves to 200ms, but don't drop the final summary. also we'll avoid remounting the live region.
hana (design): copy brainstorm — options for move message: A) 'Moved "{rule}" to position {n}', B) '"{rule}" now priority {n}', C) 'Rule "{rule}" placed at slot {n} (affects routing)'. prefer A for brevity.
kevin (pm): vote A. shorter and predictable. for conflicts: A) 'Priority conflict — rule unreachable', B) 'Conflict: rule cannot be routed', C) 'Rule skipped due to higher-priority match'. prefer short AND explicit. leaning toward A with a tooltip that expands.
jules (frontend): CSS note: the validation badge currently uses token purple-60 on purple-100 which fails WCAG for small text. i'll switch the badge to purple-80 bg with white or add a subtle outline. also the pill is absolutely positioned and overlaps the preview header at widths < 560px. changing layout to allow wrap should fix it.
phil (research): mobile testing: when the preview refreshes it steals focus from the active drag target. users expect the drag handle to keep focus. recommend keeping tabindex stable and moving visual focus only.
tom (engineer): implementation plan: 1) make drag-handle focusable and first in tab order with aria-label='Drag to reorder'; 2) persist DOM nodes to avoid full re-renders on reorder where possible; 3) srAnnouncer for moves + summary; 4) ensure toast has role='status' and is tabbable. i'll own 1+3. jules pls take 2+4.
a11y-scan: scan output: contrast fail on .rule-badge (AA small text), missing aria-label on .drag-handle, live region gets removed during updates. recommended fixes: bump contrast, keep live region mounted, add aria-label.
kevin (pm): creating tickets now: INF-3499 sr-announcer + debounce rules, INF-3500 drag-handle focus + aria-label, INF-3501 compact-preview wrap + badge contrast, INF-3502 summary-announcement + tabbable-toast. target: branch cut by Thurs, review Friday.
hana (design): small UX ask: add a tiny 'Preview how this will sound' toggle inside the simulation panel that reads the most recent announcement text inline for copywriters. helps iterate wording. could be behind a feature flag if needed.
jules (frontend): can prototype a non-voice text preview first (sr-text box) and toggle TTS later. quick win.
kevin (pm): love that. adding to INF-3499 as a subtask. thanks team.
